content.text: The config still has `gh = "latest"` and `gh` resolves to a mise shim (`~/.local/bin/gh`) which hangs trying to auto-install. Fix: remove it from config, uninstall the mise copy, and reshim.

input.command: mise uninstall gh 2>&1; mise reshim 2>&1; echo "==="; command -v gh; gh --version 2>&1 | head -2

result.output:
mise gh@2.97.0           uninstall
mise gh@2.97.0           remove ~/.local/share/mise/installs/gh/2.97.0
mise gh@2.97.0           remove ~/.cache/mise/gh/2.97.0
mise gh@2.97.0         ✓ uninstalled
===
/home/himmel/.local/bin/gh
mise gh@2.97.0           [1/3] install
mise gh@2.97.0           [1/3] download gh_2.97.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz

content.text: Still installing — there must be another config source (global or project `.mise.toml`). Checking:

input.command: ls ~/.config/mise/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat ~/.config/mise/config.toml 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls .mise.toml .mise.local.toml 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; mise doctor 2>&1 | grep -A30 "Configuration files"

result.output:
lrwxrwxrwx 1 himmel himmel 51 Jul 12 19:22 /home/himmel/.config/mise/config.toml -> ../../dev/environment/home/.config/mise/config.toml
-rw-r--r-- 1 himmel himmel 22 Aug 15 20:26 /home/himmel/dev/environment/home/.config/mise/config.toml
---
[tools]
gh = "latest"

content.text: Now removing the leftover mise shim and verifying:

input.command: mise reshim; rm -f ~/.local/bin/gh; command -v gh; gh --version 2>&1 | head -2

content.text: The earlier auto-install already re-downloaded it. Removing it fully:

input.command: mise uninstall gh@latest; mise reshim; rm -f ~/.local/bin/gh; command -v gh; gh --version 2>&1 | head -2

content.text:
Fixed. Summary:

- `gh = "latest"` is removed from `~/.config/mise/config.toml` (symlinked to your dotfiles repo)
- The mise install and leftover shim are removed
- `gh` now resolves to `/usr/bin/gh` from your yay (pacman) install
